sentence: Employee service portals make people hunt for the right system, record, owner, and form before they can solve a simple problem.
Relay begins with the employee's words.
It reads authenticated workspace records, opens the exact task or document, and prepares consequential actions for review.
A VPN issue becomes a complete IT Support request; the employee sees the destination and details, confirms the action, and receives a verified case record.
The evaluation covered seven workflow families, held-out rewordings, voice sessions, safety scenarios, and replay testing.
After the fix pass, Relay completed 103 of 110 task-success conversations and 39 of 42 held-out requests.
Its defining achievement is the shared execution contract: identity, approval, idempotency, audit history, and postcondition checks work the same way across every capability.
